info.name: Student Accommodation Finder API — GET and POST
info.description: Import this collection into Postman. Set baseUrl (default: http://localhost:5000), adminEmail/adminPassword, landlordEmail/landlordPassword, and the record IDs required by requests. Register Student creates a test account and stores its token. Login requests store role-specific tokens. Writes create persistent data. Use a disposable development database. Campus/listing creation calls the public OpenStreetMap services; do not run repeatedly or in parallel.

request.description: Public liveness check. Expected: HTTP 200 and success=true.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Register a disposable student before running student-only calls. Admin and landlord credentials must be supplied as local Postman variables.

request.description: Creates a unique disposable student account. Expected: HTTP 201; automatically saves the returned student token and ID.

exec: pm.test('success envelope and student token', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.data.user.role).to.eql('STUDENT'); });

request.description: Set adminEmail and adminPassword in the local Postman environment. Expected: HTTP 200; saves adminToken.
Set credentials for an active, verified landlord in the local Postman environment. Needed for landlord-only listing calls.
Negative authorization/business-rule test. Expected: HTTP 400; public callers cannot register admin accounts.
Requires studentToken from Register test student. Expected: HTTP 200 with the authenticated user.

exec: pm.test('returns authenticated user', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.user.role).to.eql('STUDENT'); });

request.description: Requires studentToken. Expected: HTTP 200; returned profile must not contain a password hash.

exec: pm.test('profile excludes password hash', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.user).not.to.have.property('passwordHash'); });

request.description: Public read. Expected: HTTP 200 and an array of active institutions.
Public read. Expected: HTTP 200 and an array of active campuses.
Requires adminToken. Calls the OpenAlex provider. Expected: HTTP 200, or a documented 503/502 if the provider is unavailable.

Set institutionId to an active institution UUID. Requires adminToken and calls OpenStreetMap Overpass, which is rate limited. Expected: HTTP 200 with campus suggestions, or a documented provider error.
Admin-only write; creates a persistent institution. Use a disposable database. Expected: HTTP 201; saves institutionId.
Admin-only persistent write; requires institutionId. Resolves the address through rate-limited OpenStreetMap. Use a disposable database and do not retry rapidly. Expected: HTTP 201; saves campusId.

exec: pm.test('campus created or geocoder reports a documented failure', () => pm.expect([201, 422, 502, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code));

if (pm.response.code === 201) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('campus has coordinates', () => { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.latitude).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.data.longitude).to.be.a('number'); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('campusId', body.data.id); }

item.name: Listings and student interactions
item.description: Set listingId to an approved listing UUID before running student interaction requests. Report, favourite, review, and enquiry requests create persistent records.

request.description: Public search. Expected: HTTP 200, paginated results contain approved listings only.

exec: pm.test('search response includes results', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.data.items.every(item => item.approvalStatus === 'APPROVED')).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Set listingId to an approved listing. Expected: HTTP 200 and listing details.

exec: pm.test('approved listing returned', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.approvalStatus).to.eql('APPROVED'); });

request.description: Set listingId to an approved listing. Expected: HTTP 200 and review array.

item.name: POST Submit review (student; one review per listing)

request.description: Requires studentToken and an approved listing not previously reviewed by this student. Optional comment is empty. Expected: HTTP 201; a repeat for the same student/listing returns 409.

exec: pm.test('review created or already submitted', () => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

if (pm.response.code === 201) pm.test('rating-only review accepted', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.rating).to.eql(5); pm.expect(body.data.comment).to.eql(''); });

request.description: Requires studentToken and approved listingId. Creates a persistent test report; use only in a disposable database. Expected: HTTP 201 and success message.
Requires studentToken. Expected: HTTP 200 and only reports submitted by the authenticated student.

exec: pm.test('reports returned as array', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description: Requires studentToken and approved listingId. Creates a persistent favourite; repeated saves may return a conflict.

exec: pm.test('favourite added or already exists', () => pm.expect([200, 201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Requires studentToken. Expected: HTTP 200 and favourite array.
Requires studentToken and approved listingId. Creates a conversation or returns the existing one; saves conversationId.
Requires studentToken. Expected: HTTP 200 and the student's conversations.
Requires studentToken and conversationId from Start listing conversation. Creates a persistent test message.

exec: pm.test('message persisted', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.content).to.include('TEST ONLY'); });

request.description: Requires studentToken belonging to the conversation. Expected: HTTP 200 and ordered message array.
Requires studentToken. Expected: HTTP 200 and the authenticated user's notifications.
Requires landlordToken from the verified landlord login. Expected: HTTP 200 and only that landlord's listings.

exec: pm.test('listings returned as array', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: POST Create listing (verified landlord; persists and geocodes)

formdata.value: TEST ONLY: temporary API validation listing.
Molotlegi Road, Ga-Rankuwa, Gauteng, South Africa

request.description: Requires an active verified landlord and campusId. Persistent write; geocodes the property and campus via rate-limited OpenStreetMap/OSRM. Use a disposable database and a near-campus valid address. Add a photos form-data file only if desired. Expected: HTTP 201 and PENDING approval status.

exec: pm.test('listing created or documented geocoder failure', () => pm.expect([201, 422, 502, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code));

if (pm.response.code === 201) pm.test('listing awaits moderation', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.approvalStatus).to.eql('PENDING'); });

item.name: Admin reads
item.description: All requests require adminToken from Login admin.

request.description: Expected: HTTP 200 and pending listing array.

exec: pm.test('all returned listings are pending', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.data.every(item => item.approvalStatus === 'PENDING')).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Expected: HTTP 200 and all listings. Supported statuses: ALL, DRAFT, PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED.
Expected: HTTP 200 and aggregate platform counts.

exec: pm.test('stats include listing counts', () => { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.totalListings).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(data.pendingListings).to.be.a('number'); });

request.description: Expected: HTTP 200 and report array for moderation.
Expected: HTTP 200 and landlord directory; password hashes must not be included.

exec: pm.test('user records exclude password hashes', () => { const users = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(users).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(users.every(user => !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(user, 'passwordHash'))).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Expected: HTTP 200 and audit log array.
